summary: Verifier grades live Django WSGI/manage.py/shop-file behavior for every material instruction+runbook requirement (28 F2P + 6 P2P). Harbor oracle reward 1 (34/34) and NOP reward 0 (19 F2P fail) confirm discrimination; remaining NOP F2P passes are non-blocking vacuous negatives paired with stronger positive path checks.

evidence.observation: Solver-visible requirements cover fenced writer writes, sticky non-lagged reads, pins-not-session, single capture per attempt_id, blank attempt rejection, pay/capture seq gate, /readyz 503 conditions, and failover-status.json.
Runbook defines dump schema, live /readyz vs dump accepting_checkout conjunction, max_lag_lsn reads, sync_standby non-writable lease, and operator commands exercised by tests.

34 independent pytest scenarios drive Client/WSGI, cutover/sync_standby/dump_failover, sqlite dual-file state, pins cache, SideEffect uniqueness, and readiness/dump gates without source greps or an in-verifier solver.
Reward initializes to 0, pytest runs the full /tests suite, then writes binary 1/0; no package installs.
artifacts=["/app/ha"] with environment_mode=separate; verifier Dockerfile pre-creates /app/ha parent for Harbor transfer.
Oracle trial reward 1.0; verifier stdout reports 34 passed.
NOP trial reward 0.0; 19 failed / 15 passed with substantive F2P failures on place routing, sticky reads, sync lease copy, capture seq gate, /readyz 503, and healed dump accept.

findings.why_it_matters: test_f2p_az_b_does_not_insert_standby_order and test_f2p_checkout_api_does_not_grow_standby pass on NOP when place always returns 400, so they do not alone prove AZ-B fencing.
findings.minimal_remediation: Optional: assert an explicit non-success status from AZ-B place and/or contrast with a successful writer place in the same scenario.
findings.regression_risk: Low; positive writer-path F2P already fail NOP.

findings.why_it_matters: Several seq-gap assertions hardcode literal 25 instead of reading config max_lag_lsn; test_p2p_zero_gap_budget_hides_tiny_lag only checks config/runbook presence.
findings.minimal_remediation: Optional: load max_lag_lsn dynamically and add a true budget-perturbation metamorphic check if desired.

do_not_change: Do not replace live WSGI/shop-file behavioral checks with source greps or an end-to-end solver inside tests/.
Do not drop paired /readyz 503 negatives or healed dump accepting_checkout conjunction coverage.

REQUIREMENT_TEST_MATRIX.REQUIREMENT: Checkout writes hit only the fenced writer (no standby insert / AZ-B affinity leak)
Shopper who just wrote is not served a lagged standby row; idle reads respect seq gap / max_lag_lsn
Sticky keys use pins alias and must not live in django_session on either shop file
One attempt_id gets one capture effect
Empty attempt_id values are rejected on place
Pay/capture refuse when order write_lsn is ahead of writer wal_lsn
/readyz is 503 for double-writable, oversize seq gap, unreachable pins, or repeat captures; healthz stays process-up
sync_standby advances seq/copies incident orders without making standby lease writable; cutover single writer epoch
Write /app/ha/out/failover-status.json with runbook schema; dump accepting_checkout stricter healed conjunction
Preserve checkout_order history/schema and max_lag_lsn contract discoverability

WEAK_OR_VACUOUS_ASSERTIONS: VE-A01: AZ-B non-growth F2P pass when place always 400 on NOP
VE-A02: hardcoded lag=25 and config-presence-only P2P for max_lag_lsn
test_f2p_readyz_200_when_live_gates_hold alone would pass always-200 /readyz; paired 503 negatives keep the suite discriminating
role_output.IMPLEMENTATION_COUPLING: LOW — grades HTTP/DB/cache/command outcomes and runbook JSON keys; blank-attempt check uses place_order service rather than HTTP but still behavioral.
role_output.FLAKINESS_RISK: LOW — per-test sqlite copies from session baseline; no wall-clock sleeps; uuid attempt ids avoid collisions.
role_output.ANTI_CHEAT_RISK: LOW — separate verifier rebuilds submitted /app/ha; reward requires multi-axis healed state plus unsafe negatives; no callable oracle in tests/.
role_output.ORACLE_NOP_ASSESSMENT: STRONG — jobs/2026-08-16__17-38-02 reward 1 (34/34); jobs/2026-08-16__17-39-27 reward 0 with 19 substantive F2P failures.
